Record Class GameDTO

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Network.DTO.GameDTO
Record Components:
numberOfPlayers - total number of players in the current game
currentPlayerIndex - index of the player whose turn is currently active
players - players participating in the game
upperRowCards - cards currently available in the upper row of the board
lowerRowCards - cards currently available in the lower row of the board
offerTrack - DTO representation of the current offer track state
currentPlayer - DTO that represents the player whose turn is
phase - current phase of the game
currentRound - current round number in the game
currentEra - current era of the game
turnOrderTrack - list of players in the order in which they are placed on the turn order track. First element is placed on the top slot (will place the totem first), last element is placed on the bottom one
currentUpperTaken - upper-row picks the acting player has already taken this turn (authoritative)
currentLowerTaken - lower-row picks the acting player has already taken this turn (authoritative)
currentFoodTaken - whether the acting player has already taken food this turn (authoritative)
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record GameDTO(int numberOfPlayers, int currentPlayerIndex, List<PlayerDTO> players, List<CardDTO> upperRowCards, List<CardDTO> lowerRowCards, List<OfferTileDTO> offerTrack, PlayerDTO currentPlayer, GamePhase phase, int currentRound, Era currentEra, List<PlayerDTO> turnOrderTrack, int currentUpperTaken, int currentLowerTaken, boolean currentFoodTaken) extends Record implements Serializable
Data Transfer Object that represents a snapshot of the game state to be sent over the network.
